review.notes: Full re-review. Previous R01-R08 checked one by one: R01, R03-R06 and R08 repaired (R08 apart from R3 missing in the parent paragraph); R07 partly (Lee-Parker); R02 not re-raised, since its stated reason holds (the only plan of surface disk filling is PlanarTopology/SurfaceTopology, which this roadmap may not cite). Gate: the worker's run passes; my rerun flags only the default-order NOT IN ORDER and the family-index outside-folder hit, both explained. Order-aware depcheck: 239 roadmaps, 2353 edges, 0 problems.
